protocol.name: ext_background_effect_v1
protocol.copyright: SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT Protocol source: wayland-protocols staging/ext-background-effect

interface.name: ext_background_effect_manager_v1
interface.description: This global factory creates background effect objects for surfaces.

request.name: get_background_effect
request.description: Instantiate an interface extension for the given wl_surface to add effects like blur for the background behind it.

interface.name: ext_background_effect_surface_v1
interface.description: The background effect object provides a way to specify a region behind a surface that should have background effects like blur applied.

request.name: set_blur_region
request.description: This request sets the region of the surface that will have its background blurred. NULL removes the effect.
